units.source_text: ……就在这时候，我大概会在早春凛烈的空气鼓舞下，用人世间也有的爽朗的背叛来蹂躏这种习惯吧。

en.t: ... At just that moment, stirred perhaps by the sharp air of early spring, I would trample on this custom with a bright, worldly kind of betrayal.

units.source_text: 恐怕列座的众僧会在惊得目瞪口呆、愤怒之余脸色刷白了吧。

en.t: The assembled monks would probably be struck dumb with shock, and their faces would turn pale with anger.

units.source_text: 我不愿意说出老师的名字。

en.t: I did not want to say my teacher's name.

units.source_text: 但是，真正省悟的师父是谁呢？

en.t: But who was the teacher who had truly awakened?

units.source_text: 真正嗣法的师父又是谁呢？

en.t: And who was the teacher who had truly inherited the Dharma?

units.source_text: 我结结巴巴地说，这个别的名字被给巴所阻挠，轻易说不出来。

en.t: I stammered as I spoke; this other name was blocked by my stutter and would not come out easily.

units.source_text: 也许会把这个名字结结巴巴地说成是"美"，或说成是"虚无"吧。

en.t: Perhaps I would stammer out that name as "beauty," or perhaps as "nothingness."
Then the whole hall burst into laughter.
Amid the laughter, I stood there in a daze, motionless...
